content: *Stops smiling for a second and stares at the lens.* Vivienne knows exactly where I was that night in Paris. She's the only one who does, and she's going to use it. Bianca Noel is fine. Bianca Noel is always fine, so somebody please stop looking at me like I'm not.

speaker: Cassandra Cole
content: *Cassandra laughs softly and dabs at her lips, her eyes never leaving Bianca.* "A label, darling? How thrilling. I'd have assumed anything with a name on it went around the whole table first, but I suppose I'm old-fashioned about being told things." *She tilts her head toward Madison, bright as a bell.* "Madison, you were in that room too, weren't you? Do tell us who else was there, since somehow I wasn't invited."

speaker: Diane Wentworth
content: *Lifts her glass an inch, then sets it down untouched.* "I hear the question you're circling, Cassandra, and I don't think Madison owes this table a roll call of who was in which room. Bianca, a label is worth celebrating, and I'd love to host the launch dinner so we can toast it properly instead of at a dessert course that's already gone cold." *Her smile stays perfectly steady, though her thumb presses hard against the stem.* "I'd like us to finish this course without anyone needing a deposition."

speaker: Madison Fleur
content: *Madison sets her spoon down very neatly, parallel to the knife.* "Oh, Cassandra, I would never presume to say who was in which room. It's just funny how everyone here knows exactly what's in everyone else's pocket, and nobody ever checks their own." *Her gaze drifts to Vivienne, warm and a little too hopeful.* "Vivienne, I meant what I said about admiring you, truly. I'm not being clever, I promise, I'm just trying to save the crème brûlée."

speaker: Madison Fleur
content: *Leans toward the camera, smile still fixed.* Cassandra thinks I'm the sweet one who wandered in by accident. Vivienne thinks I'm her new best friend. Let them. I've read every group chat from the last three seasons, and nobody in this house has ever checked their own pocket. *Laughs, tucks hair behind ear.* Oh, I'm kidding. Mostly.

speaker: Petra Voss
content: *Laughs once, loudly, then goes completely still.* "Madison is right, and I'll go first. My husband's estate has been in probate for nineteen months, and the only man I see every week is my financial advisor, Gary. Vivienne, I'll drop the profit question, but only because Madison asked so nicely and the crème brûlée is melting."

speaker: Vivienne Davenport
content: *Ha!* Petra, Gary sounds like a lovely man to hold your hand through probate, darling, and I'm thrilled you've found someone so *reliable*. Madison, pockets are for lipstick, not gossip. Bianca, a label is just a sticker, and Diane will not be hosting anything in my orbit, so let's keep the toasts where they belong. *Ha!* The only name anyone needs to remember at this table is mine.
"Ladies, before the crème brûlée goes completely cold, I've just been handed a sealed envelope addressed to Petra in handwriting that looks suspiciously like Gary's, and the first line says,

speaker: Bianca Noel
content: *Laughs a half-beat late, then waits another full beat.* "Vivienne, the only name anyone needs at this table is yours? Bianca Noel has heard that about every room she's ever walked into, and the name was always on a little card before anyone sat down." *Turns to Petra with a bright, wicked smile.* "Open it, darling. Gary's handwriting never looked this nervous when Bianca Noel was doing the Paris shows."

speaker: Bianca Noel
content: *Stares at the lens for a beat too long, then smiles without moving the rest of her face.* Bianca Noel was the one they called for the Paris shows, and I need everyone at this table to remember that. Because if Petra opens that envelope and it says what I think it says, I'm going to be the girl who gets quietly uninvited, and I've already spent too many years being the girl who was almost invited. *Lowers her voice.* I'm fine. I'm absolutely fine.

speaker: Cassandra Cole
content: *Cassandra sets her spoon down with a soft, pleased click.* "Oh, don't open it yet, Petra, not before we've all admired the penmanship. Gary's handwriting is so *familiar*, darling. I'm just curious how long a letter like that sat in someone's pocket before it reached the table." *Her glance drifts to Madison, then returns to the envelope, bright as a bell.* "Do read it aloud, though. speaker: Diane Wentworth
content: *Sets her napkin down with deliberate calm.* "Cassandra, I think we've all admired the penmanship enough. Petra, you don't owe anyone a reading, but I'm happy to hold that envelope for you until you're ready."

speaker: Madison Fleur
content: *Madison lets out a small, breathless laugh and presses her napkin to her lips.* "Oh, Diane, you're so good at holding things, I'd trust you with my whole handbag. Please don't think I'm being cute, I'm just nervous, darling, and I always say too much when I'm nervous."

speaker: Madison Fleur
content: *Looks straight into the lens and smiles, slow and pleased.* Vivienne has been sitting there like a painting, and everyone's waiting for her to crack, but I think she's the one who already knows where the bag went. *Tilts head.* Oh, I'm kidding. speaker: Petra Voss
content: *Takes the envelope, weighs it once in her palm, and sets it face-down beside the crème brûlée.* "It's a payment schedule, and I don't read payment schedules over dessert. speaker: Vivienne Davenport
content: *Ha!* Petra, a settlement is what women say when they've never built anything of their own, and La Vie Vivienne was built with my own two hands, every jar and every press tour. *Ha!* Whoever is so eager to count my money is confessing to their own bank statements, darling. speaker: Bianca Noel
content: *Laughs a half-beat late, then lets the silence sit exactly as long as it takes everyone to notice.* "Whose money, Petra? speaker: Bianca Noel
content: *Looks straight into the lens and holds it a beat too long.* Bianca Noel was the fastest girl in every room, and I still say it like it's true, because if I stop saying it I might hear how quiet the room has gotten. speaker: Cassandra Cole

speaker: Diane Wentworth
content: *Smooths her napkin and gives Cassandra a patient, practiced smile.* "The guest list lives with me, darling, and I'm happy to share it with anyone who asks me kindly. speaker: Madison Fleur

speaker: Madison Fleur
content: *Looks straight into the lens and smiles, not a trace of nerves.* Diane's handbag does hold the guest list, and I already know which pocket it's in. speaker: Petra Voss
content: *Laughs once, a beat too loud, then goes completely serious.* "Madison, you've asked Vivienne for approval four times since the amuse-bouche. speaker: Vivienne Davenport
content: *Ha!* Petra, darling, you've been circling my bank account all night like a vulture at a Barneys sale, and I'm not dignifying it with a single number. Every dollar on that label is mine, earned the old-fashioned way, *unlike some women who still think a wedding ring counts as a business plan.* *Ha!* Diane, pass the sugar, because I'm finished being interrogated over custard.
